svg.text: Region mix moves margin far more than product mix does
Gross margin by product and region; the same product swings up to 10.1 points
North is the largest region (23.2% of revenue) and the lowest-margin one at 34.0%;
South, a smaller region, runs 38.2% on the same four products.
Source: Q3 sales.xlsx — Orders: gross margin (revenue less cost) by product and region.
svg.desc: Product margin is flat; regional margin is not. Smart speaker runs 40.5% in Central and 30.4% in North, a 10.1-point spread on the same product; Robot vacuum spans 9.7 points. North is the largest region and the least profitable at 34.1% gross margin, against 38.2% in South.
